title: GCP IAM User Without MFA

compliance.assurance_rationale: Saved search evidence for AU-2 when alert outputs are archived.

controlTest.positiveScenario: Replay sample `google:gcp:audit` events with `eventName="CreateLoginProfile" OR eventName="DeactivateMFADevice"` into `index=gcp`. Confirm UC-4.4.71 returns >=1 row and the alert fires.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `google:gcp:audit` traffic without `eventName="CreateLoginProfile" OR eventName="DeactivateMFADevice"`. Confirm UC-4.4.71 returns zero rows and the alert does not fire.

description: UC-4.4.71 — GCP IAM User Without MFA: queries Google Cloud `google:gcp:audit` for `CreateLoginProfile`, `DeactivateMFADevice` and returns actor, resource, and region context for security review and change validation.
value: On Google Cloud, unapproved creation tied to 'GCP IAM User Without MFA' expands credential and network attack surface and often precedes persistence or crypto-mining activity. UC-4.4.71 drives high-priority security alerting before customer-impacting drift.
implementation: Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=gcp sourcetype=google:gcp:audit.
visualization: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report.
knownFalsePositives: Approved change windows; documented automation service principals; sandbox accounts excluded via lookup.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=gcp`.
• Install and configure Splunk cloud TA for GCP with the modular input for `google:gcp:audit`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.4.33.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `protoPayload.methodName` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=gcp sourcetype=google:gcp:audit.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=gcp sourcetype="google:gcp:audit" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=gcp sourcetype="google:gcp:audit" eventName="CreateLoginProfile" OR eventName="DeactivateMFADevice"
| table _time protoPayload.methodName protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail resourceName
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.4.71_gcp_iam_user_without_mfa_71"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `google:gcp:audit` in `index=gcp` to detect gcp iam user without mfa. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the GCP Logs Explorer console for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `protoPayload.methodName` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_4_71_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Splunk cloud TA for GCP and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
